name: TrueNAS
author: Vinícius Lourenço
description: TrueNAS pool health and active alerts on the Omarchy bar, with desktop notifications and a popout for pools, alerts and system state.

barWidget.description: Pool health, alerts and capacity, with a popout for everything the NAS is doing.

schema.label: What the bar shows
schema.description: Default is the active alert count when anything is firing, otherwise the fullest pool's capacity. Icon is the glyph alone, tinted by the worst state. Alerts is the active alert count. Capacity is the fullest pool. Pool is the worst pool status word. Full adds alerts and capacity. An unreachable or unconfigured NAS overrides every variant with a plug or cog: a number the plugin cannot vouch for is never printed as one.

schema.label: Hide the icon when everything is healthy
schema.description: Off keeps a dimmed glyph on the bar, which is also how you tell the plugin is alive and reaching the NAS.

schema.label: Config file
schema.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/omarchy/truenas/config.json. The API key is never stored in shell.json: it lives in the credentials file the config names, at mode 600.
